tiers.name: Default Buffered Checkpoint/mmap I/O + Hard memory.max Only (512 GiB)
tiers.note: 180GiB RSS + 48GiB /dev/shm + 290GiB active_file page cache from mmap/checkpoints exceeds 512GiB -> Kubelet Eviction / Exit Code 137!

tiers.name: Host Cron echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches Every 5 Minutes
tiers.note: Global drop_caches freezes kernel VFS spinlocks across all containers (52s I/O stall), cannot free /dev/shm tmpfs, and still OOMs during burst writes.

tiers.name: cgroup v2 memory.high Soft Throttle (440 GiB) + Guaranteed QoS
tiers.note: Setting memory.high=440GiB forces synchronous cgroup page-cache reclaim before hitting 512GiB memory.max, cutting OOMKills to 2.4%.

tiers.name: O_DIRECT / FADV_DONTNEED + memory.high (88%) + Explicit /dev/shm & Pinned Budget
tiers.note: Bypasses page cache on checkpoints (O_DIRECT), drops mmap pages post-load (FADV_DONTNEED), and budgets /dev/shm inside Guaranteed QoS -> 0.0% OOMKill!
